name: gf-social-contributions
description: French Guiana compulsory social contributions for calendar year 2026. Covers ordinary private employees and employers, social ceilings, CSG and CRDS, mandatory complementary pensions, national employer relief and the three LODEOM schedules with their Guyane eligibility conditions. Also covers ordinary artisan, trader and non-regulated liberal self-employed contributions, the reformed common social base, DOM startup exemption and later abatements, micro-social rates and payment and correction workflows. Trigger on Guyane cotisations sociales, CGSS, Urssaf, LODEOM, salaire brut net, plafond sécurité sociale, micro-entrepreneur outre-mer and indépendant DOM. Wage income tax withholding and DSN payroll fields belong to gf-payroll; investment income social levies and personal income tax belong to gf-income-tax. Profession-specific pension funds and agricultural insurance need their own schedules.
